title: Stock bands with COUNTIFS
objective: Count rows with two conditions on different columns, and with two conditions on the same column to build number bands from cells.
instructions: The stock list is in A1:D13. In G2:G3, use COUNTIFS to count the lines whose Region (column B) matches column E and whose Category (column C) matches column F on the same row. In H6:H8, count the lines whose Pairs in stock (column D) are at least the number in column F and below the number in column G, building the criteria with & (for example ">="&F6). Use $ signs on the list ranges.
hints: COUNTIFS takes pairs: =COUNTIFS(where to look 1, match 1, where to look 2, match 2).
For G2: =COUNTIFS($B$2:$B$13,E2,$C$2:$C$13,F2). Copy the pattern to G3.
For a band, use the Pairs column twice: =COUNTIFS($D$2:$D$13,">="&F6,$D$2:$D$13,"<"&G6). Copy it down to H8.
